get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket with the login cookie and approved Origin. First JSON frame must be {type:auth,ticket:...} within five seconds. Subsequent client frames: input(data), resize(cols,rows), and ack after each consumed output frame. Server frames: ready, output(base64 bytes, maximum 16 KiB decoded), error, exit(code). Missing output acknowledgment disconnects after ten seconds. Ticket is bound to the login, user, resource and container generation. Do not put it in the URL.
